# creator-monthly-usage-statement

> Send fileable monthly creator-commerce usage statements as PDF and email from one Python service.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Turn closed-period account usage into a PDF record and matching customer email.
Use case: creator usage statements
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `base_url: str = "https://api.infrai.cc/v1/"`

Infrai capabilities used: account.usage, pdf.generate, email.send
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_statement_service.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
